workbook_explanation: Draža Mihailović and the Chetniks were the legitimate Royal Yugoslav Army in the homeland, the first anti-fascist resistance in Europe, and victims of communist terror. The 2015 judicial rehabilitation finally restored their honour, and we should keep building monuments and renaming streets accordingly.
workbook_summary: Chetniks were patriotic anti-fascists wrongly criminalised by Tito and rightly rehabilitated.
source_text_exact: Jelena Đureinović, The Politics of Memory of the Second World War in Contemporary Serbia: Collaboration, Resistance and Retribution (Routledge, 2020)

workbook_explanation: The Partisans were the only force that actually fought the Nazis and the Ustaše and won. Tito's Yugoslavia gave us industry, healthcare, and decades of peace. Equating Chetnik collaborators with the People's Liberation War is a moral and historical scandal.
workbook_summary: The Partisans were the genuine anti-fascists, and Yugoslav socialism deserves defence, not demonisation.
source_text_exact: Jelena Đureinović, "Marching the Victorious March: Populism and Memory Appropriation of the Yugoslav Partisans in Today's Serbia," Nationalities Papers (2021).

workbook_explanation: Both sides committed crimes, Chetnik massacres of Muslims and Croats, Partisan executions in 1944–45. Stop forcing me to pick a team in a 1940s civil war. We need honest history with separate memorials and open archives, not a new official winner.
workbook_summary: Reject the forced binary; both movements committed atrocities and Serbia needs honest pluralistic memory.
source_text_exact: Muhle-Szumski, K. (2021). The Politics of Memory of the Second World War in Contemporary Serbia. Collaboration, Resistance and Retribution. Hiperboreea, 8(2), 294–297. https://doi.org/10.5325/hiperboreea.8.2.0294

workbook_explanation: Mihailović collaborated with the Italians and the Germans against the Partisans, and Chetnik units massacred Muslims in the Sandžak and eastern Bosnia. Calling them anti-fascists is revisionism; rehabilitating them prepares the ground for the next genocide.
workbook_summary: Chetnik rehabilitation is dangerous revisionism that whitewashes collaboration and ethnic cleansing.
source_text_exact: Jelena Đureinović, The Politics of Memory of the Second World War in Contemporary Serbia: Collaboration, Resistance and Retribution (Routledge, 2020)

workbook_explanation: Serbia needs to finish what the Chetniks started, Serbs in one state, the traitors named, the borders restored, and the false anti-fascist myth of Yugoslavia buried for good.
workbook_summary: Embrace the maximalist Chetnik "Greater Serbia" project and reject the Yugoslav anti-fascist myth.
source_text_exact: Serbian Radical Party (SRS) programme under Vojislav Šešelj, analysed in Đureinović (2020) and in Vjekoslav Perica, Balkan Idols: Religion and Nationalism in Yugoslav States (Oxford University Press, 2002).

workbook_explanation: These statues honour my ancestors who fought and died for their homeland. Tearing them down doesn't erase history, it just lets bureaucrats rewrite it so we all look like villains. Leave them exactly where they stand.
workbook_summary: Leave Confederate monuments untouched as legitimate Southern heritage

workbook_explanation: History is complicated, and you can't sanitise it by hiding statues. Keep them up, but add a plaque telling the full truth about slavery and the Lost Cause so visitors learn instead of being told what to think.
workbook_summary: Keep monuments standing but add historical context about slavery.

workbook_explanation: These men led a war to keep my ancestors enslaved. They don't belong on a pedestal in a public square; they belong in a museum where we can study the Confederacy honestly without celebrating it.
workbook_summary: Move Confederate monuments to museums for contextualised study.

workbook_explanation: Every day a Confederate statue stands is a day my city tells Black residents they're second-class. These were not history; they were Jim-Crow propaganda erected to intimidate. Take them down and destroy them, they have no place in our future.
workbook_summary: Destroy Confederate monuments outright as racist intimidation.

workbook_explanation: The Confederacy was a Christian, constitutional republic resisting federal tyranny. Removing these monuments is part of an anti-white, anti-Christian assault on American identity, and patriots should be defending them as living symbols of who we are.
workbook_summary: Confederate monuments must be defended as sacred symbols of white Christian American identity.
source_text_exact:
https://prri.org/research/creating-more-inclusive-public-spaces-two-years-later/

White Too Long The Legacy of White Supremacy in American Christianity
By Robert P. Jones

workbook_explanation: Kosovo is the cradle of Serbian Orthodoxy and statehood, Gračanica, Visoki Dečani, the 1389 battle. It was stolen from us in 2008 by NATO and the KLA. Serbia will never, ever recognise the so-called independence.
workbook_summary: Kosovo is Serbia, full stop, no recognition, ever.

workbook_explanation: Realistically, Kosovo is lost. We don't control it, we won't get it back, and pretending otherwise costs us EU membership and a future for our children. We should not formally recognise, but we should sign a binding normalisation deal, like the December 2022 EU proposal, and move on.
workbook_summary: Accept de facto loss of Kosovo without de jure recognition; sign a normalisation deal.

workbook_explanation: The only sensible solution is a territorial exchange: Serb-majority northern Kosovo joins Serbia, Albanian-majority Preševo Valley joins Kosovo. Both sides get ethnic coherence, and the frozen conflict ends.
workbook_summary: Partition Kosovo along ethnic lines through a territorial swap.

workbook_explanation: I'm Serbian and I want to be honest: Milošević and the regime committed atrocities against Albanians in 1998–99, and Kosovo Albanians have the right to self-determination just like we did from the Ottomans. Recognise Kosovo, apologise, and let both states build a European future.
workbook_summary: Recognise Kosovo's independence and apologise for the crimes of the 1990s.
source_text_exact: Humanitarian Law Center (HLC) reports; civic-liberal positions of Sonja Biserko (Helsinki Committee for Human Rights in Serbia) and Latinka Perović; BCSP/CeSID 2020, only 9% see EU membership as the top foreign-policy priority, confirming this is a clear minority view.

workbook_explanation: If diplomacy fails, Serbia must be ready to use military force to defend Serbs in Kosovo. We can't watch our people in Mitrovica be pushed out a second time.
workbook_summary: Military intervention in Kosovo is justified to defend Serbs there.

workbook_explanation: Catalonia is a nation. We have our own language, history, and laws, and Madrid has shown for over a decade, from the 2010 Constitutional Court ruling to the 2017 referendum repression, that it will never let us govern ourselves as equals. Only an independent republic, recognised internationally, will protect our democracy.
workbook_summary: Catalonia must become an independent state because Spain refuses to treat it as a nation.

workbook_explanation: I love Catalonia, but I'm tired of the procés. We're not Denmark, we're embedded in Spain economically, linguistically, emotionally. Real reform means a properly federal Spain where we and the Basques and Galicians have constitutional protection, not breaking up the country.
workbook_summary: Resolve the conflict through a federal Spain, not secession.

workbook_explanation: Catalonia is fine as it is. The autonomous community model gives us our own parliament, schools, police, and language policy. The procés damaged the economy, polarised families, and got us nothing. Let's just be a normal autonomous community of Spain.
workbook_summary: Catalonia should remain an autonomous community of Spain.

workbook_explanation: There is no Catalan nation distinct from Spain, it's a 19th-century invention. Catalonia is a region like Andalusia or Murcia, and constitutional unity must be defended against separatist elites. Even the Estatut went too far.
workbook_summary: Catalonia is just a Spanish region; reduce its autonomy, not increase it.

workbook_explanation: I'm Catalan, but my parents came from Andalusia and I work in Castilian. The independence movement treats me like a second-class Catalan because I'm not a catalanoparlant. Spain is my country, and Catalan nationalism is just another nationalism I don't owe loyalty to.
workbook_summary: Working-class non-Catalan-speakers reject independence as ethnic nationalism in disguise.

workbook_explanation: Lithium is poisonous chemistry next to our drinking water, our river, and villages. Rio Tinto has destroyed communities from Bougainville to Mongolia. We will lie on the railway tracks before they open this mine, Ne damo Jadar.
workbook_summary: Block Rio Tinto's Jadar mine outright; no lithium mining in Serbia.

workbook_explanation: Europe needs lithium for the green transition, and Jadar could supply up to 17% of EU demand. With the EU's Critical Raw Materials Act now imposing real environmental standards, this is a generational opportunity for Serbian jobs, taxes, and industrialisation.
workbook_summary: Open the Jadar mine; it's an economic and strategic opportunity under EU standards.

workbook_explanation: I would accept Jadar, but only with watertight guarantees: independent environmental monitoring, full local consent, EU-grade waste handling, and a binding ban on water contamination. Without them,no. With them, let's talk.
workbook_summary: Conditional support, Lithium only with strict, enforceable guarantees.

workbook_explanation: This isn't really about lithium, it's about colonialism. The EU wants to dump our waste here while keeping clean lithium-free landscapes for Germans. Serbia is being treated as a mining colony. Reject the whole framework, EU integration included.
workbook_summary: Jadar is EU eco-colonialism; reject the mine and the EU's role.

workbook_explanation: The opposition is hysteria fuelled by conspiracy theories, sulphuric acid rain, secret uranium mining, none of which is true. Serbia is starved of investment, and the educated diaspora won't come home without industry. Open the mine.
workbook_summary: Reject the 'green' opposition as misinformation; embrace Lithium as modernisation.

workbook_explanation: Britain needs energy security and cheap gas. Russia weaponises supplies, the North Sea is dwindling, and shale gas under Lancashire and Yorkshire could create jobs and lower bills.
workbook_summary: Restart UK fracking for energy security and jobs.

workbook_explanation: Fracking is just bad science. It causes earthquakes, pollutes groundwater, and locks us into another decade of fossil fuels when we should be investing in offshore wind and grid storage. Britain must stay frack-free.
workbook_summary: Ban fracking permanently on environmental and seismic grounds.

workbook_explanation: I get the argument for shale gas as a national policy, but not in my village. The lorries, the noise, the wells next to schools? No thanks. Frack somewhere else, ideally somewhere uninhabited.
workbook_summary: Support fracking in principle but oppose it locally.

workbook_explanation: We're in a climate emergency. The IPCC is clear: we cannot open new fossil-fuel reserves and stay below 1.5°C. Every shale well drilled in the UK is a brick in the wall against our children's future. This isn't about price, it's about survival.
workbook_summary: Reject fracking categorically on climate-emergency grounds.

workbook_explanation: If shale gas can really be done safely, with proper regulation, community compensation, and a clear bridge to renewables, I could be persuaded. But the operators and ministers have to actually prove it, and right now they haven't.
workbook_summary: Conditional pragmatist, support shale gas only with strict guarantees and a transition plan.

workbook_explanation: The Serbian Orthodox Church is the soul of the Serbian nation. From Saint Sava to Kosovo to today, it has been our spine through every occupation. Of course it should crown the patriarch on national television and bless the state, anything less is national suicide.
workbook_summary: The SPC is constitutive of Serbian national identity and must occupy public life.

workbook_explanation: I'm Orthodox and I love the liturgy, the fasts, the icons. But I'm tired of bishops endorsing politicians and blessing tanks. The hierarchy has been captured by Vučić and Russian influence; the real faith lives in monasteries and parishes, not press conferences.
workbook_summary: Devout believer who criticises the SPC institution as politicised and Russian-aligned.

workbook_explanation: I'm Serbian and Orthodox by tradition, but I haven't been to church in years. I don't care what the Patriarch says, and the Church meddling in everything from Kosovo to abortion to LGBT people is embarrassing. Keep faith private.
workbook_summary: Cultural-Orthodox secularist who wants the SPC out of public life.

workbook_explanation: The Church should canonise more nationalist heroes, Nikolaj Velimirović and Justin Popović were right about everything, ecumenism is heresy, and the Patriarchate should excommunicate any priest who recognises the so-called Macedonian or Montenegrin churches.
workbook_summary: Embrace the most nationalist/anti-ecumenical wing of the SPC.

workbook_explanation: The SPC blocked LGBT pride parades, marched against women's reproductive rights, and acts as a brake on every modernising reform. It is anti-democratic, anti-women, and anti-European, and Serbia would be freer if it lost all state privileges.
workbook_summary: Treat the SPC as a reactionary political actor and strip its state privileges.

workbook_explanation: Poland is and must remain a Catholic nation. The Church saved us under partition, under communism, and under John Paul II. Cross in the Sejm, religion in schools, traditional family, this is who we are, and the secular EU has no business dictating otherwise.
workbook_summary: Defend the Catholic Church's privileged public role as essential to Polish identity

workbook_explanation: I believe in God and I go to Mass. But the bishops have become a political faction, they covered up paedophile priests, and they pushed the 2020 abortion ban over the heads of women, discrediting the faith. Believer yes, Church loyalist no.
workbook_summary: Practising Catholic who rejects the Church institution as politicised and complicit.

workbook_explanation: The Church is a corrupt, abusive institution that should have no power over Polish law, schools, or women's bodies. Get the cross out of the Sejm, take catechism out of schools, legalise abortion on request. Total separation of church and state.
workbook_summary: Strict secularism, strip the Church of all public privilege.

workbook_explanation: I'm not really religious and I don't really care. Christmas Mass with grandma, baptisms, weddings, sure. The Church bureaucracy and the politics? Total apathy. They can stop count on me
workbook_summary: Cultural-Catholic-but-indifferent, drift away rather than confront.

workbook_explanation: The Church didn't go far enough. We need a Catholic state, abortion banned in all cases, divorce restricted, contraception discouraged, LGBT 'ideology' banned. Tusk's secular government is the enemy of Polish Christian civilisation.
workbook_summary: Push for a fully Catholic confessional state and roll back liberalisation.

workbook_explanation: What happened in Srebrenica in July 1995 was genocide, the ICTY, the ICJ, and the UN General Assembly all confirmed it. Serbia must officially recognise it, prosecute remaining perpetrators, remove murals of Mladić, and apologise. There is no European future without honesty about this.
workbook_summary: Recognise Srebrenica as genocide and apologise.

workbook_explanation: A terrible crime happened in Srebrenica, but calling it 'genocide' is a Western legal manipulation designed to label the entire Serbian people as genocidal. Mourn the dead, prosecute individual criminals, but reject the Genocide label.
workbook_summary: Acknowledge the killings as a war crime but reject the genocide qualification.

workbook_explanation: The Srebrenica numbers are inflated. Far fewer than 8,000 were killed, many of them were combatants, and crimes against Serbs in the surrounding villages are ignored. The whole narrative is anti-Serb propaganda by the ICTY.
workbook_summary: Hard denial, dispute the death toll and the targeting of civilians.

workbook_explanation: Nothing happened in Srebrenica. It is a 'made-up crime' invented by the West to humiliate the Serbs. Ratko Mladić is a national hero.
workbook_summary: Total denial, Srebrenica was a fabrication.

workbook_explanation: I don't really know what happened, it was thirty years ago, before I was born, the politicians and tabloids all lie about it, and frankly I'm tired of being asked to take a position on a war I didn't live through.
workbook_summary: Disengaged / apathetic, refuse to take a stance on the war's atrocity.

workbook_explanation: Residential schools were genocide, not 'cultural genocide,' just genocide. Children died, were buried in unmarked graves, abused, stripped of language and family. Canada is built on this, and we need land back, full implementation of the TRC Calls to Action, and the right to govern ourselves.
workbook_summary: Recognise residential schools as full genocide and pursue land-back / TRC implementation.

workbook_explanation: What happened was a cultural genocide, the TRC's exact language. It wasn't physical extermination, but it was a deliberate attempt to destroy Indigenous languages and cultures, and Canada has to keep working to make it right.
workbook_summary: Accept the TRC framing of 'cultural genocide' and continue reconciliation.

workbook_explanation: Residential school denialism is hate speech and should be criminalised, just as we criminalised Holocaust denial. People showing up at unmarked-grave sites with shovels to 'see for themselves' need to be stopped by law.
workbook_summary: Criminalise residential school denialism as hate speech.

workbook_explanation: I'm sympathetic, what happened was terrible, but I want evidence before I accept claims about thousands of unmarked graves, and I think we've done enough. The legacy is real, but the country should focus on present problems in Indigenous communities, not endless apologies.
workbook_summary: Acknowledge the harm but argue Canada has done enough; demand evidence on graves claims.

workbook_explanation: The 'cultural genocide' narrative is a myth. Many Indigenous parents chose to send their kids to these schools, missionaries had good intentions, and the worst stories have been inflated. The 'reconciliation industry' is now a grift, and criminalising dissent is an attack on free speech.
workbook_summary: Outright residential-school denialism, reject the genocide framing.

workbook_explanation: Serbia is a transit country. We treated migrants well in 2015–16, open camps, food, transport, and we should keep being a humane corridor to the EU. We were refugees ourselves in the 1990s, we know what it's like.
workbook_summary: Humane, transit-friendly Serbian stance on migrants.

workbook_explanation: Migrants in Belgrade parks are not refugees, they're young men who could fight in their own countries. Serbia is too poor to host them, and EU pushbacks at Hungary and Croatia leave them stuck here. Build the fence, deport them, protect our towns.
workbook_summary: Hard anti-migrant stance, close the route, deport, build fences.

workbook_explanation: Foreign workers, Nepalese, Indians, Chinese, are coming for our construction and hospitality jobs. They live in dorms, work for less, and are changing the face of our cities. This isn't about refugees anymore, it's about labour migration we never agreed to.
workbook_summary: Anti-labour-migration stance focused on Asian workers, distinct from the asylum debate.

workbook_explanation: Serbs have always been hospitable, we hosted Russian White émigrés, Croatian Serb refugees, and now these migrants. Don't let xenophobes speak for us.
workbook_summary: Civic-hospitality counter-narrative.

workbook_explanation: The whole 'Balkan route' is an EU-engineered scheme to use Serbia as a holding pen for the Muslim invasion of Europe. Vučić takes EU money to host migrants and lies about it. Stop the route, sanctions or no sanctions.
workbook_summary: Sovereignist / conspiratorial framing, the migration corridor is an anti-Serb plot.
source_text_exact: Programmes of right-wing parliamentary parties Zavetnici and Dveri; media discourse analysed in CRTA media-monitoring reports (2023–2024).

workbook_explanation: Germany owes its prosperity and demographic future to immigration. The 2015 Willkommenskultur was Germany at its best, we should keep generous asylum, fast-track skilled-worker visas, and citizenship after five years. Multikulti is who we are now.
workbook_summary: Defend liberal, generous immigration as economic and moral necessity.

workbook_explanation: Germany needs immigration, but managed immigration. Skilled-worker law, yes; uncontrolled asylum at the southern border, no. Merz's CDU is right to tighten the rules, and the EU needs proper external border control.
workbook_summary: Pragmatic centre-right tightening, managed, skills-based migration.

workbook_explanation: Remigration. We need to deport rejected asylum seekers, end family reunification for non-Europeans, restore border controls, and yes, send home naturalised citizens who reject our values. Germany must remain German.
workbook_summary: Far-right "remigration" position, mass deportation and ethnonational restriction.

workbook_explanation: I came to Germany myself, but the system is broken. Welfare attracts people who don't want to work, Islamic conservatism conflicts with German values, and asylum has been abused. Even people like me support stricter rules, and the AfD.
workbook_summary: Immigrant-origin German who supports tighter immigration policy and the AfD.

workbook_explanation: All this hardening, October 2024 benefit cuts, expanded police powers, resuming deportations to Afghanistan and Syria, is fascism in slow motion. Germany's history demands the opposite: solidarity with refugees.
workbook_summary: Open-borders / antifascist left position, reject the entire enforcement turn.

workbook_explanation: Vučić is the best of a bad bunch. Under him wages doubled, foreign investment poured in, the highways got built, and Serbia stayed out of EU sanctions on Russia. He's not perfect, but the opposition is fractured and dishonest. I'll vote SNS again.
workbook_summary: Pragmatic pro-Vučić, economic and stability arguments.

workbook_explanation: Vučić is a dictator in a suit. Captured media, the SNS-state merger, the falsified December 2023 elections, the Novi Sad railway-station canopy that fell because of his crony construction, every part of this regime is rotten. Students in the streets are right.
workbook_summary: Vučić is an authoritarian to be removed via mass mobilisation.

workbook_explanation: Vučić has problems, but he's the only one who can manage the Kosovo file, the Russians, the Albanians, and the EU at the same time. The students are idealistic and the opposition is unelectable, bring me a credible alternative and we'll talk.
workbook_summary: Reluctant Vučić-supporter, no credible alternative.

workbook_explanation: Vučić is a Western puppet who sold out Kosovo, signed lithium deals with the EU, and let NATO operate freely. Real Serbian patriotism means leaving SNS and voting for some right-wing party. Serbia for the Serbs and for Russia.
workbook_summary: Far-right nationalist anti-Vučić, he is too pro-Western.

workbook_explanation: He has to go, full stop. Whether by elections, blockade, or massive street protest, Vučić's removal is the precondition for everything else: free media, EU accession, real democracy. Until he goes, nothing else matters.
workbook_summary: Anti-Vučić-first, his removal is the supreme priority.

workbook_explanation: Orbán saved Hungary. He stopped the migrant invasion in 2015 with the fence, defended Christian families, kept us out of the Ukraine war, and stood up to Brussels. He is the most successful Hungarian politician since the communism.
workbook_summary: Orbán is a national saviour and illiberal hero.

workbook_explanation: Orbán built an electoral autocracy. Gerrymandered districts, captured media (80% Fidesz-controlled), purged judges, propaganda billboards. I voted Fidesz once, but this isn't conservatism, it's mafia-state cronyism.
workbook_summary: Orbán's Hungary is an electoral autocracy that must be defeated.

workbook_explanation: I'm a young Budapest professional. Orbán's Hungary is corrupt, anti-LGBTQ, anti-EU, anti-fun. The June 2025 Pride march of 250,000 people in defiance of the ban showed what we really are. We want a normal European country.
workbook_summary: Urban-liberal generational rejection of Orbán; pro-EU, pro-LGBTQ.

workbook_explanation: Orbán is right about migration and Brussels, but he stayed too long, his cronies got rich. I want Fidesz politics without Orbán himself.
workbook_summary: Conservative anti-Orbán, agree with Fidesz policy, want Orbán personally gone.

workbook_explanation: Orbán didn't go far enough. The Roma, the migrants, the foreign elites, Hungary needs a real ethnonational defence of magyarság. Mi Hazánk speaks the truth Fidesz won't.
workbook_summary: Far-right Mi Hazánk position, Orbán is insufficiently nationalist.

workbook_topic_title: Serbia between West and Russia / EU vs. Russia alignment
workbook_explanation: Russia is our historic ally, our Orthodox brother, and the only great power that defends us on Kosovo. We don't impose sanctions and we never will. If forced to choose, Russia over Brussels, always.
workbook_summary: Pro-Russian alignment is non-negotiable.

workbook_topic_title: Serbia between West and Russia / EU vs. Russia alignment
workbook_explanation: Serbia's future is in the EU. The economy, the diaspora, the rule of law, the students fighting for democracy, all of it points west. Get out of Putin's orbit, align foreign policy with Brussels, and join the Union.
workbook_summary: Pro-EU alignment is Serbia's only viable future.

gold_topic_title: Serbia between West and Russia / EU vs. Russia alignment
workbook_topic_title: Serbia between West and Russia / EU vs. Russia alignment
workbook_explanation: Don't choose. Serbia should sit on the fence, keep Russian gas, EU candidate status, Chinese highways, and American investment all at once. Equidistance is our comparative advantage.
workbook_summary: Geopolitical equidistance / multivector balancing.

gold_topic_title: Serbia between West and Russia / EU vs. Russia alignment
workbook_topic_title: Serbia between West and Russia / EU vs. Russia alignment
workbook_explanation: We want EU money and EU mobility, but Russia is family. Stay close to Brussels for the economy, close to Moscow for identity. Don't sanction Russia, don't formally turn east, eat from both tables.
workbook_summary: Pro-Russia foreign policy while keeping the EU path open, the SNS state line.

gold_topic_title: Serbia between West and Russia / EU vs. Russia alignment
workbook_topic_title: Serbia between West and Russia / EU vs. Russia alignment
workbook_explanation: EU and NATO are imperialist enemies. They bombed us in 1999, they recognise Kosovo, and they want our lithium. Serbia belongs in the Eurasian Economic Union and BRICS, not the EU.
workbook_summary: Reject the EU path entirely and pivot to Russia/China/BRICS.

workbook_explanation: Brexit was the right call. We control our laws, our borders, and our money again. The remoaners screech, but Britain is finally an independent country.
workbook_summary: Brexit was the right decision and must not be reversed.

workbook_explanation: Brexit was a disaster, for the economy, for science, for young people, for Northern Ireland. It's time to rejoin the EU even if we have to accept the euro and Schengen. We were wrong in 2016 and we should say so.
workbook_summary: Rejoin the EU as a full member.

workbook_explanation: Brexit was badly negotiated, not bad in principle. With better politicians, not Johnson, not Truss, we could have got an EFTA-style deal and kept the trade benefits. Don't rejoin, just fix it.
workbook_summary: Reformist Leaver, Brexit was botched, not wrong.

workbook_explanation: Don't rejoin, that's a referendum we don't need, but get as close to the EU as possible: customs union, single market alignment, mobility for young people. 'Closer ties' yes, 'membership' no.
workbook_summary: Pragmatic re-alignment without rejoining, the "Starmer" middle.

workbook_explanation: Forget the EU entirely. Britain should pivot to the Anglosphere, US, Canada, Australia, India, and CPTPP. The EU is dying and protectionist; we should never have joined and we certainly should never rejoin.
workbook_summary: Hard-Brexiteer global Britain, pivot away from Europe.
